requirements.title: Omitted STATUS= defaults to UNKNOWN
requirements.definition: If STATUS= is omitted, the default value is UNKNOWN.

pending.status-default-unknown: No portable oracle observes the omitted STATUS= token UNKNOWN directly: R1231 and 12.10.2 define no INQUIRE STATUS= specifier, so there is no result variable to prefill with a sentinel and compare to UNKNOWN. Because 12.5.6.19 also makes STATUS=UNKNOWN select a processor-dependent status, future fixtures may test portable effects of explicitly specified OLD, NEW, SCRATCH, or REPLACE, but must not assert the default UNKNOWN token or the status selected through it.

accounting.rationale: STATUS= p1 mixes value set and file-existence restrictions.
STATUS= p2 combines NEW, REPLACE, and SCRATCH file effects.
STATUS= p3 combines UNKNOWN processor latitude and omitted default.
Omitted STATUS= default to UNKNOWN, whose status is processor dependent.
Note cross-references the FILE=/SCRATCH rule; notes are not normative and the restriction is registered under 12.5.6.10.

review_rationale: Source registration for the OPEN statement and its specifiers, 12.5.6.1-12.5.6.19 (batch151). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds. Round 1 found required OPEN defaults with only generic plans and required default tokens over-suppressed as unobservable; both are now concrete sentinel-prefilled INQUIRE plans (ACCESS, ASYNCHRONOUS, BLANK, DECIMAL, DELIM, FORM, PAD, LEADING_ZERO, SIGN, and ROUND as set membership). Rounds 2 and 3 found that INQUIRE(POSITION=) reports connection STATE, not the omitted OPEN token, and that a re-OPEN plan observes 12.5.6.1 p6 rather than the POSITION default; the omitted POSITION= token is now recorded as not portably observable, as are the STATUS and ENCODING default tokens. The eight numbered rules R1204-R1207 and C1203-C1206 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
